name: 185. A first-token deadline also ends a stream attempt stalled while connecting (acquisition-first-token)
description: A stream attempt with a first-token deadline (a routing rule target's ttft_timeout_ms) must end at that deadline even when it never gets a connection: DNS, the dial and a proxy handshake all happen while the connection is acquired, before any socket exists for the header-wait watcher to close. The row creates a run-scoped OpenAI-backed provider on the provider error fixture whose proxy_config points at the fixture's stall proxy (tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, PROVIDER_ERROR_FIXTURE_STALL_PORT, default 8799), which accepts the connection and never answers the CONNECT, plus a fallback provider on the fixture itself, and routes a streamed request to the first with a 500ms deadline. Red before TXE-5374 (the attempt waited for the proxy until the fixture dropped the connection after 15 seconds), green after (b serves at about 500ms). Needs the same gateway and fixture as the routing-error-fixture folder: run with providerErrorFixture=1, providerErrorFixtureUrl when the fixture is not on http://127.0.0.1:8791 and providerErrorFixtureStallProxyUrl when its stall proxy is not on http://127.0.0.1:8799. Skipped otherwise. No live provider calls.
